description: A painting of a night scene in snow at a stone monastery gate lit by torches. A slim youth in a dark tunic stands in an open doorway while a woman in a black veil sits behind him. Kneeling men in fur-trimmed brocade robes and fur hats face him, and a bearded cleric in gold vestments raises a gilded icon of the Virgin and Child. Black-robed clergy kneel with scrolls, and a crowd of townsfolk holds torches. Onion domes and a wooden gallery sit in the background.
